lines.en: label library10:
scene upsidedownredux1
I stop by the library first thing this morning.
lines.zh: 今天早上我第一站就去了图书馆。

lines.en: The impending exams that had flipped this place on its head recently have finally ceased to be and Futaba and I can now go back to being normal.
lines.zh: 前阵子把这里搅得天翻地覆的那场迫在眉睫的考试终于结束了，Futaba 和我现在可以回到正常状态了。

lines.en: Or at least as normal as we can be as a student and the man who is trying to fuck her.
lines.zh: 或者至少，在一个学生和那个想操她的男人之间，能有多正常就有多正常。

lines.en: : Thanks so much for helping out lately, Sensei. I really don’t know what I would have done without you.
lines.zh: : 最近真的太感谢你帮忙了，老师。我真不知道没有你该怎么办。

lines.en: : I’m sure you would have managed. It’s just a library after all.
lines.zh: : 我相信你自己也应付得来。毕竟只是个图书馆而已。

lines.en: : Calling it {i}just{/i} a library really diminishes the work I do, you know.
lines.zh: : 你把它说成「{i}只是{/i}个图书馆」，可真是在贬低我做的工作啊。

lines.en: : If I had been doing everything on my own, organizing all of the shelves would have taken twice...or maybe even three times as long.
lines.zh: : 如果全靠我一个人，整理所有书架要花上两倍……搞不好是三倍的时间。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have had any time left to write that assignment you gave me.
lines.zh: : 那样我就没时间写你布置给我的那篇作业了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That's a thing I asked you to do.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。那是我让你写的。

lines.en: : How is that coming, by the way? We haven’t really talked much about it since then.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，写得怎么样了？从那以后我们都没怎么聊过这件事。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux2
: I, uhh...
: I think...I’m finally ready to show you something.
lines.zh: : 我想……我终于准备好给你看样东西了。

lines.en: : But it's not done yet, so...you have to promise not to laugh if it doesn’t live up to your expectations...
lines.zh: : 不过还没写完，所以……你得答应我，如果达不到你的期望，也不许笑我……

lines.en: : Don't worry, Futaba. I won't laugh even if it's the worst thing I've ever read.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Futaba。就算是我这辈子读过最烂的东西，我也不会笑。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux3
: Was that...supposed to make me feel better? Or...
lines.zh: : 这话……是在安慰我吗？还是说……

lines.en: Futaba nervously slides a notebook across the table to me.
lines.zh: Futaba 紧张地把一个笔记本从桌上推了过来。

lines.en: I quickly flip through the pages to find that her story is the only thing written in it.
lines.zh: 我迅速翻了翻，发现里面只写了她那篇故事。

lines.en: Why she decided to write it in the {i}middle{/i} of the book instead of where any sane person would write it, I have no idea.
lines.zh: 她为什么决定写在书的{i}中间{/i}，而不是任何一个正常人都会写的地方，我完全不明白。

lines.en: But it appears to be only a few pages long, so I should be able to knock it out rather quickly.
lines.zh: 不过看起来只有几页长，我应该能很快读完。

lines.en: : Futaba...You know you could have used your normal notebook, right? You didn’t have to buy a new one just for this.
lines.zh: : Futaba……你知道你可以用平时的笔记本吧？不必特意为这个买本新的。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux4
Futaba shakes her head once in disagreement. The long braid draped over her shoulder dances across her chest and quickly catches my eye before settling back in place.
lines.zh: Futaba 摇了摇头表示不同意。垂在她肩上的那条长辫子在她胸前晃动，很快吸引了我的目光，随后又落回原处。

lines.en: : I figured it would be best to buy a new one so you wouldn't go snooping through my notes.
lines.zh: : 我觉得还是买个新的比较好，这样你就不会去偷看我的笔记了。

lines.en: : Oh? Are you keeping something in there that I should be worried about?
lines.zh: : 哦？里面藏了什么我该担心的东西吗？

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux5
: ’Worried’ probably isn't the right word...But I’d definitely prefer if you didn’t see anything in there.
lines.zh: : 「担心」大概不是合适的词……但我确实很希望你别看到里面的任何东西。

lines.en: : I get it. It’s not unusual for a girl your age to want some privacy.
lines.zh: : 我懂。你这个年纪的女孩想要点隐私，并不奇怪。

lines.en: : I guess I'll just have to ask one of your classmates what sorts of things you've been writing about me in there.
lines.zh: : 看来我只好去问你的某个同学，你在里面都写了些关于我的什么了。

lines.en: : Umm...please don't.
lines.zh: : 呃……请别这样。

lines.en: : I was kidding. Your notes are {i}your{/i} notes and...all I'll read is whatever you just handed to me.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。你的笔记就是{i}你的{/i}笔记……我只读你刚刚递给我的那些。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux4
: Thank you, Sensei...But again, please don't expect too much.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，老师……但还是那句话，请别抱太大期望。

lines.en: : You've already surpassed my expectations with this avant-garde approach of writing in the middle of the book, so I'm already at the edge of my seat.
lines.zh: : 光是「写在书的中间」这种前卫手法，你就已经超出我的预期了，我现在可是坐直了身子等着看。

lines.en: : Well, I-
scene upsidedownredux6
: Wait, what? The middle of the book?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？书的中间？

lines.en: scene black
I carefully flip back to the start of the story and begin to read...
lines.zh: 我小心地翻回故事的开头，开始读了起来……

lines.en: Futaba quickly gets out of her chair and stands beside me, causing me to think for a moment that maybe she'd given me the wrong notebook on accident.
lines.zh: Futaba 迅速从椅子上站起来走到我身边，让我有一瞬间以为她是不小心拿错了本子。

lines.en: But once I begin reading and she doesn't stop me, I realize that might not be the case at all.
lines.zh: 但当我开始读而她并没有阻止我时，我意识到事情可能根本不是那样。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux7
: What is-
lines.zh: : 这是——

lines.en: : That's not my handwriting...
lines.zh: : 这不是我的字迹……

lines.en: : {i}Somewhere, in the middle of nowhere, there is a house.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在某个偏僻荒凉的地方，有一栋房子。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This house, which seems ordinary on the outside, is actually anything but.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这栋房子外表看起来平平无奇，实际上却完全不是那么回事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You see, this house is upside down.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你看，这栋房子是上下颠倒的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Normally, if you flip a house on its head, the people inside of it will fall down.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通常来说，如果把一栋房子翻个底朝天，里面的人就会掉下来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But the girls living in this one don’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可住在里面的女孩们不会。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In fact, some of them even prefer to live this way.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}事实上，她们中有些人甚至更喜欢这样生活。{/i}

lines.en: I pause for a moment and wait to see if Futaba has anything to say, but she remains as still and silent as a corpse.
lines.zh: 我停顿了一下，等着看 Futaba 有没有什么要说的，可她像尸体一样一动不动、一言不发。

lines.en: : {i}You see, this house sits at the edge of the universe.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你看，这栋房子坐落在宇宙的边缘。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And much like the country we live in, this place has its own set of rules.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就像我们居住的国家一样，这个地方也有它自己的一套规则。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don’t stay up too late, don’t eat more food than you require in a day, and don’t question Papa.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不要熬夜太晚，不要吃下超过一天所需的食物，还有不要质疑爸爸。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s that easy!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就是这么简单！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As long as the rules are followed, everyone can live a happy life devoid of any negative feelings whatsoever.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只要遵守规则，每个人都能过上毫无任何负面情绪的幸福生活。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s a truly wonderful place!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真是个美妙的地方！{/i}

lines.en: : Umm...Futaba...What exactly am I reading?
lines.zh: : 呃……Futaba……我到底在读什么啊？

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux8
: I have no idea...I've never seen this book in my life.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道……我这辈子从没见过这个本子。

lines.en: : So...you just happened to give me someone {i}else's{/i} creative writing project instead?
lines.zh: : 所以……你只是碰巧把{i}别人{/i}的创作作业递给我了？

lines.en: : It's okay to be embarrassed with your work, but denying that you wrote it is just-
lines.zh: : 对自己的作品感到不好意思没关系，但否认是你写的就有点——

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux9
: I really didn't write this, though! I swear!
lines.zh: : 可这真的不是我写的！我发誓！

lines.en: : Well, did you swap notebooks with someone on accident or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，你是不是不小心跟谁换了笔记本之类的？

lines.en: : I...I don’t think so? I hadn't even taken this one out of my room until today...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得没有？直到今天之前，我根本没把这个本子拿出过房间……

lines.en: : I don’t understand this at all...
lines.zh: : 我完全搞不懂这是怎么回事……

lines.en: : Should we keep reading? It's not over yet.
lines.zh: : 我们要继续读吗？还没完呢。

lines.en: : I...suppose we can? But this is...really starting to weird me out.
lines.zh: : 我……大概可以吧？但这……真的开始让我发毛了。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux10
Futaba moves a little closer to me as I try to find where we left off...
lines.zh: 我努力找我们刚才读到的地方时，Futaba 又往我身边凑近了一点……

lines.en: : {i}There are so many books here, yet none of them say anything. I wonder why that is?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这里有这么多书，可它们全都什么也没说。我想知道这是为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is it because I’ve already read them, or because I simply cannot see?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是因为我已经读过了，还是因为我根本看不见？{/i}

lines.en: : Whose perspective is this coming from?...
lines.zh: : 这是谁的视角啊？……

lines.en: : I don’t know. It was being narrated a minute ago, but...it seems to have swapped storytellers or something.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。刚才明明还是旁白在讲，但……好像换了讲故事的人之类的。

lines.en: : This is so weird...I have no idea how this happened...
lines.zh: : 太诡异了……我完全不知道怎么会变成这样……

lines.en: I continue reading.
lines.zh: 我继续读了下去。

lines.en: : {i}The smell was horrible coming from the boiler room.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}锅炉房里传来的气味难闻极了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It was like burnt rubber mixed with rotting flesh. A truly horrible scent.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}像是烧焦的橡胶混着腐肉的味道。真是可怕的气味。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No matter how hard I try to forget it, it clings to my nostrils and sticks in my hair.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}无论我怎么努力想忘掉，它都黏在我的鼻孔里、沾在我的头发上。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It makes me want to shed my skin.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它让我想把自己的皮蜕下来。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. That's enough of that.
lines.zh: : 好了。读到这里就够了。

lines.en: I abruptly close the notebook and toss it back onto the table.
lines.zh: 我猛地合上本子，把它扔回桌上。

lines.en: Futaba looks down at it for a moment like she's caught in a daze before sitting back down to regain her composure.
lines.zh: Futaba 低头看了它一会儿，像是陷入了恍惚，随后重新坐下来，努力恢复镇定。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux11
: I don't get this at all...it was a brand new notebook...
lines.zh: : 我完全搞不懂……那可是个崭新的本子啊……

lines.en: : You don’t think...Rin could have a similar notebook or something, do you? Or maybe she's just trying to fuck with you?
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得……Rin 也有个差不多的本子之类的吧？或者她只是在故意捉弄你？

lines.en: : You two share a dorm. I don't think it's impossible that she-
lines.zh: : 你们俩住同一间宿舍。我觉得也不是不可能她——

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux12
Futaba starts shaking her head before I can even finish my sentence.
lines.zh: 我话还没说完，Futaba 就开始摇头。

lines.en: : It’s not possible. I’ve read Rin’s writing before and it’s nothing like this. The handwriting is different too.
lines.zh: : 不可能。我以前读过 Rin 写的东西，跟这个完全不一样。字迹也不同。

lines.en: : This is just plain creepy...
lines.zh: : 这简直就是毛骨悚然……

lines.en: : It was definitely weird...but I wouldn't put past someone as weird as her to write something like this.
lines.zh: : 确实很怪……但像她那么古怪的人，我觉得她也写得出来这种东西。

lines.en: : It wasn't Rin, Sensei...I'm absolutely certain of that.
lines.zh: : 不是 Rin，老师……这一点我绝对确定。

lines.en: : Well, I guess it would probably be for the best to just throw that thing away or...bring it to the lost and found or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我看最好还是把那玩意儿扔掉，或者……送到失物招领处之类的。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux13
: I agree. I'll be sure to do that as soon as I leave here today.
lines.zh: : 我同意。今天一离开这儿我就去办。

lines.en: : As for {i}your{/i} story, do you think it’s still in your dorm room somewhere?
lines.zh: : 至于{i}你的{/i}故事，你觉得它还在你宿舍房间的什么地方吗？

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux14
: I really hope so! I've been working hard on it and...am not comfortable with anyone other than you reading it just yet.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望是！我一直在很用心地写，而且……现在还不愿意让你以外的人读到它。

lines.en: : Well, check when you get back and let me know. It sucks we couldn’t read it today after all the effort you put in.
lines.zh: : 嗯，回去后找找看，然后告诉我。你费了那么多心思，结果今天没读成，挺可惜的。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux15
: It’s fine. If anything, I’m sorry that you had to read something as weird as...whatever {i}that{/i} was just now.
lines.zh: : 没关系。要说抱歉的话，倒是我很抱歉让你读到刚才{i}那种{/i}……不知该怎么形容的怪东西。

lines.en: : There’s no need to be sorry, Futaba. Well, unless this is some really abstract, confusing prank that you're pulling on me. If that's the case, you can apologize and I will accept.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉，Futaba。不过呢，如果这是你对我搞的某种非常抽象、让人摸不着头脑的恶作剧，那你可以道歉，我会接受的。

lines.en: scene upsidedownredux16
: I'm not really the type of person to play pranks on others...nor would I understand how this would even count as a prank.
lines.zh: : 我不是那种会捉弄别人的人……而且我也不明白这怎么能算恶作剧。

lines.en: : Then I guess we'll just have to live in a state of perpetual mystery in which we never discover why this happened or who was responsible for it.
lines.zh: : 那看来我们只能一直活在永恒的谜团里，永远查不出为什么会发生这种事，也不知道是谁干的。

lines.en: : I'll ask Rin just to be sure, but...again, I really don't think it was her...
lines.zh: : 我会去问问 Rin 确认一下，不过……还是那句话，我真的觉得不是她……

lines.en: : Let's just try to put it behind us for now and...hang out like we always do. Without any weird boiler rooms or indiscernible narrators.
lines.zh: : 我们暂时把它放到一边，然后……像平时一样一起待着吧。不要有什么奇怪的锅炉房，也不要有分辨不出是谁的叙事者。

lines.en: : Good idea, Sensei...I know we didn't read much of it, but...
lines.zh: : 好主意，老师……我知道我们没读多少，不过……

lines.en: : That story was really starting to make me feel a little uncomfortable...
lines.zh: : 那个故事真的开始让我有点不舒服了……

lines.en: scene black
Futaba and I continue to talk for the rest of the morning, never once returning to the words found inside of that strange notebook.
lines.zh: 那个上午接下来的时间里，我和 Futaba 继续聊着天，一次也没有再提起那个奇怪本子里的内容。

lines.en: She wasn't the only one who felt uncomfortable, though.
lines.zh: 不过，感到不舒服的不止她一个人。

lines.en: Even now, each time I think about it, it feels like my stomach is tying itself in knots.
lines.zh: 即便是现在，每次想起这件事，我都觉得胃里像打了个结一样。

lines.en: Or at least something like that.
lines.zh: 或者至少是类似的感觉。

lines.en: I eventually leave the library.
lines.zh: 最终我离开了图书馆。

lines.en: The knots untie themselves.
lines.zh: 那些结自己解开了。

lines.en: $ library10 = True
$ futaba_love += 1
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
